title: 621. Reshape the Matrix

examples.explanation: Four values flow into one row in order.
Cell counts differ, so the input returns unchanged.
Six values fill three rows of two.

hints: First compare r * c against m * n; on mismatch return the input unchanged.
Map flat position k to old cell (k / n, k % n) and new cell (k / c, k % c).
One linear pass over all cells fills the new matrix in row-major order.
